_: Marriages performed by ULC ministers have been annulled by some New York state courts and upheld by others. Weddings in New York City require the officiant to register.
Legal at state level, but ULC-performed marriages that took place after July 3, 1981 may be regulated at the local level

While Viriginia as a whole does not recognize marriages performed by ULC ministers, the Virginia State office of the Attorney General determined in 2021 that local-level court clerks may choose to validate said marriages on a case-by-case basis

A 2019 Tennessee law outlawed marriages performed by ministers who had been ordained over the internet, as ULC pastors are. The law has been challenged in court and as of late 2024, reports indicate that enforcement of the law is inconsistent.
